verdict.rationale: Bulk public-data downloads are a fair axis for a government immigration agency, so the story applies. The evidence pack documents only consumer-facing application, eligibility and processing-time pages, with no bulk datasets, registry extracts or downloadable statistics. Published processing-time pages and email alerts are adjacent web content and alerts, not machine-readable bulk extracts.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
